description: A clock with two pulse outputs, the second running at a set percentage above or below the tempo of the first, with a resync that restarts both

params.text: Sets the tempo of both channels, 30 to 360 pulses per minute
Offsets the channel b tempo from the tempo knob, -10% to 10%
Attenuates and inverts the channel b offset CV, -1 to 1, before it is added to the offset knob
Restarts both channels' counters and fires a pulse on each at that instant

inputs.text: A rising edge past 1V restarts both channels' counters and fires a pulse on each
Shifts the channel b offset by 2% per volt with the attenuverter fully clockwise, and the total offset is clamped between -10% and 10%

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse to 10V at the rate set by the tempo knob
A 1ms pulse to 10V at the tempo knob's rate altered by the channel b offset

notes: the two channels are free-running counters, so any offset at all pulls them steadily apart; the resync button and the resync input are the only things that bring them back together
nothing on the panel is lettered; the artwork carries the module name and no control labels at all

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
